items.title: AMD Stock Rallies Nearly 8% as a Bernstein Analyst Remains Bullish Despite the Hunterbrook Short Report
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock rebounded 7.79% on Monday after the chipmaker’s shares experienced a rough couple of days last week. The rally of AMD stock came alongside praise from one of Wall Street’s top analysts. Five-star Bernstein analyst Mark Newman reiterated a Buy rating and a $650 price target for AMD stock, implying a possible 43.74% upside.
